occurrences.text: And, behold, there was a man in Jerusalem, whose name was Simeon; and the same man was just and devout, waiting for the consolation of Israel: and the Holy Ghost was upon him.
And there were dwelling at Jerusalem Jews, devout men, out of every nation under heaven.
And devout men carried Stephen to his burial, and made great lamentation over him.

source: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890) and Concise Dictionaries (1894), public domain; JSON by Open Scriptures (CC BY-SA).
